entities.summary: Shaun Morgan (b. 1978-12-21, Pietermaritzburg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Pietermaritzburg and South Africa. Known in the fields of south africa, composers & musicians, africa.
